{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Display basic info
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f'\nNumber of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}')

# Check unique values in customer_segment
print(f'Unique customer_segments: {df["customer_segment"].unique()}')

# Check conversion rate for each segment
# But first, we must clean revenue
# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
# Also, drop QA and refunded orders

df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Now compute conversion rate per segment
conversion_rates = filtered_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Output conversion rates
print('\nConversion rates by segment:')
print(conversion_rates)

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
print(f'\nHighest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}')"}
